integrity: The metric is recomputed from the defining representative classes using two independent ordinary-Ulam implementations. Maximum size, complete maximum-code census, one-factorization structure, and the cell-label orbit are all regenerated exhaustively from the 90 ambient codewords.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification for the 2013 Farnoud--Milenkovic cell-rank convention only: six labeled cells, multiplicity two, three ordered ranks, and minimum regular Ulam distance three. No claim is made for the later alternative multipermutation correspondence, larger lengths, other multiplicities, or other distances.
title: Complete equality classification for a six-cell two-regular Ulam multipermutation code
